title: Monitor resume preserves worker completion
description: Set FARMSLOT_GATEWAY, FARMSLOT_SIGNAL_PROOF_RUN_ID and FARMSLOT_SIGNAL_PROOF_SHA256 to prove the original signal survives a later monitoring window.

original-completion.intent: Use run.get, run.probeWorkerSignal and fs.read to prove acceptance of an unchanged terminal signal matching the worker attempt, despite the newer monitor timeout clock.

freshness-guards.intent: Verify wrong attempts, stale legacy signals, released native leases and already-consumed operator handoffs remain rejected.
